history.summary: IDENTITY UNCERTAIN: no web source confirms a 'Bhadrakali Sametha Veerabhadra Swamy' temple at Kallur, Khammam. The only Veerabhadra shrine traceable in Kallur is the 'Sri Veerabhadra Swami Temple' at Khankhanpet listed on JustDial (4.2 stars, 11 ratings) — this file documents that shrine as the best-supported referent, and the CSV's 'Bhadrakali Sametha' prefix is unverified (flagged). Temples bearing the exact 'Bhadrakali Sametha Veerabhadra Swami' name exist only in other towns — at Kotha Thanda, Tekulapalle mandal (Bhadradri Kothagudem district) and at Rathisthambam Bazar, Garla mandal (Mahabubabad district) — so the CSV row may conflate two different shrines; if the CSV intends the Tekulapalle/Garla shrine instead, this row needs reassignment. Founding date and festival details are unavailable; the deity list reflects the verified referent (Veerabhadra) only. CSV TOWN FLAG: the CSV town 'Khammam' is wrong — the referent is at Khankhanpet, Kallur town, ~50 km from Khammam town; corrected to Kallur. District (Khammam) and state (Telangana) are correct.

name: Sri Bhadrakali Sametha Veerabhadra Swamy Temple (Kallur)
town_description: Kallur (Kalluru) is a town and mandal headquarters in Khammam district, Telangana, about 50 km from Khammam town. It was once a Qutub Shahi taluka headquarters and is known for its cluster of old temples, including the Venu Gopala Swami temple and nearby Shiva shrines.

travel.road: Kallur is ~50 km from Khammam town by road
